recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray #E6E6E6. 2. Center a bold serif title at top (~36-40 pt): 'AVERAGE POOLING ' in #CC0000, 'Layer' in #0000CC, ' (Take Average Value)' in #CC0000. 3. Below, left-aligned, add three bold italic serif lines (~20 pt): line 1 dark blue #00008B 'It is a new Module (Average-POOLING module)'; line 2 red #CC0000 'Output = 1/r c * Summation (each_input_pixel * 1)'; line 3 dark blue 'Required to define its input, its output , and Gradient of Output w.r.t input'. 4. Insert a white rectangle with a 1.5-2 pt red (#CC0000) border spanning ~x 8-92%, y 38-90%. 5. Inside, create four bullets with small open-circle orange markers: (a) 'Run a sliding window of size [h_f , w_f]' with h_f, w_f as italic serif subscripts; (b) 'At each location keep the average value' with 'average' bold and underlined; (c) 'Activation function:' — draw a thin blue-bordered rectangle around this label with blue text, and to its right insert the equation a_{r,c} = (1/(r·c)) Σ_{i,j∈Ω(r,c)} x_{ij} using the equation editor; (d) 'Gradient w.r.t. input' — blue-bordered box around the label, followed by the equation ∂a_{r,c}/∂x_{ij} = 1/(r·c). 6. Build the 'Where:' legend: rectangle with #CCE4FF fill and red border; 'Where:' in red bold italic; five rows 'r Row', 'c Column', 'f filter', 'h Height', 'w width' with letters red bold italic and words dark-blue bold italic. 7. To its right, build a 4x4 table of equal squares with bold black centered numbers and these fills — Row 1: 1 green #00A651, 4 green, 1 yellow #FFFF00, 6 yellow; Row 2: 2 green, 3 green, 0 yellow, 9 yellow; Row 3: 1 red #FF0000, 2 red, 7 cyan #00B0F0, 1 cyan; Row 4: 4 red, 1 red, 0 cyan, 2 cyan. 8. Place a black '⇒' arrow to the right of the 4x4 grid. 9. Add a red stacked fraction '1/2' and then a 2x2 table: 5 on green, 8 on yellow, 4 on red, 5 on cyan (bold black numerals). 10. Do not reproduce the thin black strip at the very bottom — it is the video player bar, not slide content.
